title: Ternary phase diagrams: Flory-Huggins binodal, spinodal, tie-lines and critical point for polymer, solvent and non-solvent systems
description: A browser program for Flory-Huggins phase diagrams of polymer, solvent and non-solvent systems, as used to plan membrane casting by phase inversion: binodal, spinodal, tie-lines, critical point, cloud points of a casting dope, and downloads of every curve. The only measured data are nine published cloud points (Ishaque 2020), cited in the program.
